scripts.build: hugo --gc --minify && node scripts/glossary-inject.mjs && npm run pagefind
scripts.build:pages: hugo --gc --minify --baseURL https://o92.github.io/blog/ && node scripts/glossary-inject.mjs && npm run pagefind
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes serve public -p 1313
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit scripts/audit/run.sh scripts/git-pre-commit-audit.sh scripts/audit/deep.py && git config --get core.hooksPath
